title: Article 38 — State to secure a social order for the promotion of welfare of the people

content.overview: Article 38 directs the State to strive to promote the welfare of the people by securing a social order in which justice — social, economic and political — informs all institutions of national life, and to minimise inequalities. Verify official text for clause structure including later amendments.

sections.heading: Welfare and social order
sections.body: Article 38 is a broad welfare directive. It supports legislative programmes aimed at reducing structural inequality. It is not itself a damages clause.

sections.heading: Track B
sections.body: Point to the statute or scheme that implements the policy. Equality and non-arbitrariness challenges remain under Article 14 where State action is involved.
